name: @intellectual-frontiers/findings
description: Test results from other tools (SARIF, OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite and Nessus reports) read into findings that keep where they came from, with a lifecycle (open, triaged, accepted for a time, fixed, verified or reopened by a retest) worked out from a log of events, and the NIST SP 800-53 controls each finding is evidence against. It reads reports and runs no tool.

scripts.verify: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun ../tools/mizan-check.ts --root spec-kit && bun ../libraries/src/check.ts --root spec-kit --level L1 && bun ../kanon/src/check.ts && bun tools/check.ts && bun test suite/
